result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on quadratic relations of the form (x+y-z)^2-4xy=0 among four variables x,y,z,t with a parameter α, and their product equal to a multiple of √(xyzt), together with the identity a^2(yt+xz)+b^2(xy+zt)+c^2(yz+xt)=0 under a+b+c=0 (apparently related to theta-function / Göpel-type relations).

Expansion leading to expression of 4√(xyzt) as combination of xt+yz and yt+xz
